name: @abbit/abbit-mcp
stderr:
Usage: abbit-mcp [options] [command]

Abbit local stdio MCP adapter

Options:
  -V, --version                                                          output the version number
  -h, --help                                                             display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                                                        Authorize Abbit MCP in your browser or with a personal or service key
  status                                                                 Show local Abbit MCP authentication status
  logout                                                                 Forget an API key locally and revoke browser OAuth credentials
  serve                                                                  Serve the Abbit MCP adapter over stdio
  attachment-upload <trackerId> <itemId> <uploadId> <file>               Stream a local file to an initiated Tracker upload; complete and publish through MCP
  attachment-download <trackerId> <itemId> <attachmentId> <destination>  Download an original Tracker attachment to a new local file, verifying its SHA-256
  help [command]                                                         display help for command
